\(A=\left\{1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8\right\},M=\left\{\left(x_{i},y_{i}\right)\mid x_{i}\in A,y_{i}\in A\right\}\) ，从\(M\)中选出\(n\)个有序数对构成一列： \(\left(x_{1},y_{1}\right),\cdots ,\left(x_{n},y_{n}\right)\) ．相邻两项 \(\left(x_{i},y_{i}\right),\left(x_{i+1},y_{i+1}\right)\) 满足： \(\begin{array}{l}\left|x_{i+1}-x_{i}\right|=3\\\left|y_{i+1}-y_{i}\right|=4\end{array}\) 或 \(\begin{array}{l}\left|x_{i+1}-x_{i}\right|=4\\\left|y_{i+1}-y_{i}\right|=3\end{array}\) ，称为\(k\)列．

(1)若\(k\)列的第一项为 \((3,3)\) ，求第二项．

(2)若 \(\tau\) 为\(k\)列，且满足\(i\)为奇数时， \(x_{i}\in \{1,2,7,8\}\) ：\(i\)为偶数时， \(x_{i}\in \{3,4,5,6\}\) ；判断： \((3,2)\) 与 \((4,4)\) 能否同时在 \(\tau\) 中，并说明；

(3)证明：\(M\)中所有元素都不构成\(k\)列．
